newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end at record close.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end at record close.

text.p: 1520 GMT - Swiss shares ended a mixed session at a record level on Friday although the blue-chip SMI index failed to overcome resistance at 5,400. Dealers said Wall Street's firm opening gave the market a late push higher.
Buying centred on blue chips but selected second-tier shares were also in demand.
* Broad SPI up 14.56 points to a record 3,420.56 high.
* Blue-Chip SMI up 20.4 to a 5,384.6 record close. The SMI reached an intra-day high of 5,397.9 failing to top the psychological 5,400 level.
Soffex trade was mostly quiet but gained some pace toward the close when Wall Street firmed.
Volatilities in Soffex options as well as in warrants decreased during the course of the day. Bank Leu's volatility index eased 25 basis points to 25.02.
The index futures traded around the fair value for most of the day, dealers said.
The SMI June futures rose 20.4 points to 5,384.6 on 4,493 contracts.
